acceptance.given: Frontmatter input is processed by the parser under the SM-A03 validation contract.

oracle.expected: Parsing completes with zero YAML or object constructor executions, yielding safe data or a controlled parse failure.
forbidden: Instantiating arbitrary objects from frontmatter input
oracle.observable: Instrumented constructor counters and parser outcome during the frontmatter-parser test.

acceptance.then: Frontmatter parsing completes with constructor-execution instrumentation reporting zero YAML and object constructor calls.
acceptance.when: During a controlled frontmatter parse, instrument parser constructors and inspect the parse outcome and constructor counters.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The frontmatter-parser test fails if constructor instrumentation cannot be installed, the parser cannot be invoked, or constructor counters are not observable.
The real frontmatter parser test fails when any YAML or object constructor executes during parsing.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Parse frontmatter through a safe data-only path that never executes YAML or object constructors while preserving existing validation behavior.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes; rollback restores the prior frontmatter parsing implementation.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frontmatter input transitions from parser processing to a completed parse result with zero constructor executions.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The focused frontmatter-parser validation passes with constructor counters equal to zero and the bounded validation command exits successfully.
